name: requAIre

red_flags: Current imprint identifies Aachen, not the supplied Cologne location. Founded_year reflects the incorporated company; the idea originated in October 2024. name: Hydroyal
investors: KTH Ventures, formerly KTH Holding;Propel Capital
grants: Vinnova Innovative Impact Startups, 2023; Swedish Energy Agency concept-development grant, SEK 500,000, 2024; Vinnova SAWE H2/Acceleration of Deeptech, SEK 1,541,740, November 2024–January 2026; CETPartnership ThinCoatAEM project, launched December 2025; Net Zero Industry COMET-CCM project listed October 2026; KTH Innovation pre-incubator, STING Testdrive Deeptech and SpinLab class 20.
one_line: Develops and manufactures precious-metal-free catalyst-coated membranes and membrane electrode assemblies for green-hydrogen electrolyzers.
red_flags: The supplied German location is incorrect: this is Swedish Hydroyal AB, an aktiebolag, registered in Solna; its website gives an operating address in Kista. Registration date is December 27, 2022, while the website describes January 2023 as its official start. Institutional investment is confirmed, but its amount is undisclosed; UNKNOWN avoids assuming either side of the USD 500,000 threshold. Public funding databases report conflicting totals, so funding_total_usd is null. Product_live reflects investor-confirmed prototype sales; ordering/testing requires an enquiry rather than self-service checkout. Partner logos were not treated as customers. No current vacancy was found. Team estimate reflects three employees reported in the latest public accounts, not verified November 2026 headcount. An exhaustive 12-month press count was not established.
